title: Traditional British Shepherd's Pie
description: A classic British dish made with ground meat and topped with a layer of mashed potatoes. This recipe is a hearty and comforting meal for any occasion.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and carrot to the pan and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and set aside.
Peel the potatoes and chop them into large chunks.
Boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot.
Add the milk, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes and mash until smooth.
Spread the mashed potatoes over the top of the ground beef mixture in the baking dish.
Bake the shepherd's pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
